status: proposal; root must freeze real input, corpus, hardware and order before launch
compiler: exact rustc -vV, cargo -V and executable SHA256 captured at prepare and checked at build
cold_definition: fresh process file read + original v8 decode/conversion/from_parts/Arc, excluding marker dwell and selector setup; OS file cache is not flushed, so this is cold ownership, not cold filesystem cache
input_lifetime: input retained through completed decode/conversion then dropped before hot reads and routing; no encode call or retained wire output in probe

sampling.current: Mach task_info resident_size on macOS, /proc/self/statm with sysconf page size on Linux
sampling.peak: getrusage ru_maxrss separately; startup field before input read
sampling.process_group: immutable helper ps group RSS sampling until leader reaped and pipe closure; peak accumulator survives exit
sampling.cpu: getrusage self user+system ns; no subprocess in Rust probe

route_warmup: one full three-lane selector sweep before the measured eight sweeps; all warm results consumed then dropped

routes.schema: 10 integer columns: from x z plane, to x z plane, bits, facts, radius, model
lanes: find_with_model: model only, original default state/options semantics
routes.facts: exact frozen ccff4bb facts(0..6) extracted byte-for-byte
routes.p99: nearest-rank pooled three-lane call durations, includes numeric result consumption/drop; lane CPU separately

noise_policy: baseline max-minus-min repeat range in each metric; inconclusive if range >= gate or median delta +/- range straddles gate; retain every pair and failures, never rerun until favorable
root_freeze_required: clean and counting generated qualification hashes
exclusions: Darwin does not qualify Linux hard-AS
no zero allocation claim for route workspace/results
allocator usable sizes are not resident pages
sampling can miss short RSS spikes; OS process HWM reported separately
